name: location-maps-navigation-tracking
objective: Close Captain location, GPS, maps, navigation and tracking from device permission through DSH canonical readback, including privacy and weak-network recovery.
truthOwner: DSH owns canonical Captain tracking state; device GPS/location is input, and client/operator views are authorized projections only.

tasks.objective: Bind Captain location writes to actor and active assignment
tasks.currentProblem: Location samples can become stale/cross-actor truth if the backend trusts caller identifiers or the UI assumes success.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace pushLocation request through API/auth/persistence and canonical readback; derive actor server-side where possible, validate assignment ownership and stale/duplicate samples, and make ambiguous retries safe.
tasks.targetState: Only the current assigned Captain can advance canonical tracking and readback is monotonic/actor-isolated.
tasks.action: Trace write/readback end-to-end, fix actor/assignment/staleness/idempotency gaps and add backend/database tests.
mustNotChange: Device GPS status is not canonical server acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: Newer canonical location is not overwritten by stale samples.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused tracking changes without restoring cross-actor or stale-write behavior.

tasks.currentProblem: Permission, GPS, network and assignment changes can leave maps showing fabricated or stale progress.
tasks.requiredChange: Exercise granted/denied/revoked location, GPS disabled, offline/reconnect, stale timestamp, assignment cancellation/reassignment and navigation route changes; align any approved background task with native config or remove unused background capability.
tasks.targetState: Map/tracking presentation accurately reflects canonical state and permission/network uncertainty.
tasks.action: Test physical/runtime states, fix presentation and native lifecycle, and remove any ungoverned background collection/config.
acceptanceCriteria: Offline/unknown state is explicit and recoverable.
Background capability matches Product Truth or is removed.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused native/map changes while preserving privacy and canonical tracking ownership.
tasks.commitBoundary: Focused map/native lifecycle commit with device proof.
